title: Stephano Dedalo, alumno optimo, palmam ferenti
html_source: “Stephen Dedalus, excellent student, bearing palms.” The palm-bearing alludes to those who greeted Jesus at his triumphal entrance into Jerusalem, the adoring crowd who “took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna.” John 12:13.
